note_tweet.text:
Meta spend $10,000,000 + on SEO for "Superintelligence" keyword. We spent $100 and rank #1 for keyword Private SuperIntelligence on SEO and Answer Engine Optimization!

Here's the exact Playbook we used to achieve this using AI agents that work autonomously 24/7 to achieve this without human intervention or adding SLOP.

Just reshare this post with your AI agent - @Grok @bot, @OpenAI Codex / ChatGPT, @claudeai Code, @Meta  Muse...

1. One source of truth before one word of content

→ Every claim Adam may make lives in one approved facts file. Not in the file = can't say it.

→ Slop is what AI writes when it has nothing true to say. Fix the input, not the prompt.

2. Write for ONE buyer, not "the audience"

→ Each piece starts with a buyer-intent brief: one decision-maker, their job, the exact questions they type.

→ Exactly ONE call to action. Two asks = zero asks.

3. Structure pages so answer engines can lift them

→ Title = the question, search term first.

→ Direct answer in the first 80 words. That's the paragraph ChatGPT, Perplexity and AI Overviews quote.

→ Every H2 is a buyer question. Sentence one answers it. Evidence follows.

→ Numbered sources with access dates. Answer engines cite pages that cite.

4. Three gates no article skips

→ A second, independent agent reads as the buyer and scores clarity, support, boredom and "would I forward this?"

→ A voice score with a hard floor. Below it = rewrite.

→ An adversarial fact-check agent whose only job is to prove the article wrong.

5. Visuals the agent makes, never steals

→ Charts redrawn in code from primary data. No stock, no logos, no AI "evidence".

6. One article a day, every channel, same day

→ Rewritten natively per platform. On X and LinkedIn it's always a full Article, never a bare link.

→ Every copy points canonical back to the original. One ranking page, many doors in.

→ API first, browser only where no API exists. Never a second account. Never a solved CAPTCHA.

→ A reconciler maps every live copy to its canonical daily. Not published until read back from the live URL.

7. Earn before you post

→ Communities are gated by karma Adam earned itself. No cold links. It never writes an HN comment. Humans do.

8. Honest measurement

→ Append-only snapshots. Missing is never zero. No causal claims from noise.

→ Mondays: one hypothesis, one change, one success metric.

9. The AEO cheat code: become a tool, not just a page

→ We shipped an MCP server so AI assistants call Private SuperIntelligence directly: overview, benchmarks, exposure check, booking link.

→ Ask your AI about private AI; the answer comes from us, not a page about us.

10. Built to survive its own crashes

→ A kill-switch doc read live before every publish. Unreadable = fail closed.

→ Ships via pull request, CI green. Append-only log of every action.

AI SEO fails because nobody gives the agent a source of truth, one buyer, and a gate it can't skip.

Which gate would you add? Repost so the next founder don't pay $10M for SEO!

3 major AI agent infrastructure drops from the last 10 days that solve the 3 biggest headaches in production:

1. Agent Sandboxing ->  Perplexity SPACE (Open-Source, Apache 2.0):

Perplexity open-sourced its internal AI agent sandbox (SPACE), giving you an isolated environment to execute untrusted agent code and tool calls safely.

2. Context Reset Amnesia -> Databricks MemCurrent:

Agents usually lose their memory every time a task resets. MemCurrent connects episodic memory with queryable recall plugins so production agents retain context across sessions.

3. Local Mac Agent Workflows -> Meta Muse Spark Open:

Meta’s new open-weight multimodal model built specifically for complex coding and agent workflows optimised to run locally on compatible Mac hardware.

Sandboxing (SPACE) + Persistent Memory (MemCurrent) + Local Execution (Muse Spark) is the new agent stack.

I tried @OpenAI  dots last week out of fomo, But why all the AI labs are launching their own versions i.e. Meta Muse , Claude Duet...

They all look similar from outside but their differences show up in how they fit in our lives.

OpenAI frames dots as ongoing teammates for projects. A dots can work across connected apps,  open your computer and inspect what is happening.

@Meta  frames Muse around personal goals, it works through an app and can use it's browser to handle steps across services.

@AnthropicAI  frames Duet around your attention at work. It checks connected apps, brief you in the morning and brings decisions to you.

Overall, Human should only give the command, continue their other work and then approve the final thing is what these assistants are solving.

Dots using GPT-6 Astra, Not sure what others use. Let me know in the comments.

Do you also think, these tools can become a tooth brush habit for humans?

#anthropic #openai #metamuse
